description: This file contains the implementation of the UserGroup class within the Opencart Admin Model namespace. It provides methods for managing user groups, including adding, editing, deleting, retrieving, and managing permissions.

classes.name: UserGroup
classes.description: Represents the user group management functionalities in the OpenCart admin module, including CRUD operations and permission handling.

methods.name: addUserGroup
methods.description: Inserts a new user group into the database with given data, including name and permissions.

methods.name: editUserGroup
methods.description: Updates the specified user group's name and permissions.

methods.name: deleteUserGroup
methods.description: Removes a user group from the database based on its ID.

methods.name: getUserGroup
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific user group, including name and permissions, by ID.

methods.name: getUserGroups
methods.description: Fetches a list of user groups with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalUserGroups
methods.description: Returns the total count of user groups.

methods.name: addPermission
methods.description: Adds a specific permission (route) to a user group's permission set.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes a specific permission (route) from a user group's permission set.
